description: Line absorbers' k-distributions per 1 nm cell reduced from the ExoMol line list SiOUVenIR for 28Si-16O, as its archive holds it (rendering plan R08, R08.T4.f; decision-r08-t4ef-storage; decision-r08-t4e-budget; decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md sections 9-11), written by apps/hyperion/scripts/atmosphereData.mjs exomol-k-distributions-merge from the fetched files named here, which are not committed. Adapted material of the ExoMol database, offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 (README.md beside this directory, and NOTICE). The cells are in the binary parts listed, little-endian: HYKD, u16 version, cells, variants, temperatures, pressures and 0; then per cell u16 nm, u16 G, f64 ln sigma (m2 a molecule) of code 1, f64 its step, G f64 weights, and u16 codes over variants x temperaturesK x pressuresPa x g, g fastest, code 0 for sigma 0, else ln sigma = offset + step (code - 1). pressuresPa are air-equivalent broadening pressures; a two-variant table's values are mixed at fixed g by the self share of the Lorentz width. A cell of G = 1 is stored as its mean (decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md section 9).
source: ExoMol line list SiOUVenIR for 28Si-16O, as its archive holds it (S. N. Yurchenko, J. Tennyson, A.-M. Syme et al., ExoMol line lists - XLIV. Infrared and ultraviolet line list for silicon monoxide (28Si16O), Mon. Not. R. Astron. Soc. 510 (2022) 903-919, DOI 10.1093/mnras/stab3267); J. Tennyson et al., The 2024 release of the ExoMol database: molecular line lists for exoplanet and other hot atmospheres, J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transf. 326 (2024) 109083, DOI 10.1016/j.jqsrt.2024.109083
fetched: 2026-10-29, from the database's archive on Zenodo (ExoMol's own site was not reachable from the reducing machine)
terms: CC BY-SA 4.0, the ExoMol database's licence ('All data in ExoMol is released under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0) licence', https://www.exomol.com/data/licence/, as read 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-13); the files fetched from the database's archive of each dataset on Zenodo, whose records state CC BY 4.0 (read 2026-10-29); the values here are reduced from them, adapted material offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 (README.md beside this directory, and NOTICE); the line lists' files are not committed (decision-r08-licences.md)
reduction: SiO's A-X hot bands and its other systems in the range (SiOUVenIR, R08.T4.f), from 1000 K (E2). Each 1 nm vacuum cell's absorption at each node from super-lines: every line's S(T) (ExoMol's intensity formula, Q(T) from the list's .pf, times the isotopologue's natural abundance) binned linearly on a wavenumber grid of a twelfth of the Doppler half-width at 13100 cm-1 (the heaviest isotopologue's where a table takes several), finer than a tenth of the narrowest Voigt half-width; at each node the bins over the cell and 25 cm-1 each side, coarsened by a whole factor while the step stays under a tenth of the node's narrowest Voigt half-width and a 600th of the cut-off (0.042 cm-1), their binning's response divided out, and convolved by FFT with Voigt profiles (Humlicek 1982) cut off 25 cm-1 from each bin at every pressure, at the Doppler widths of the cell's two edges blended linearly in wavenumber; sampled at the cell's points as R08.T4.d's lines are. Every line takes the list's default air width (cm-1 per bar at 296 K, ExoMol's unit), estimated, so that every node's line shape is estimated; sorted into its k-distribution and reduced to two-point Gauss-Legendre g-intervals shared by every node of the cell, by bisection to 8e-4 in T over every column; temperature nodes on E1' (decision-r08-t4e-budget section 1.4: 50 K steps to 1000 K, then each step the largest multiple of 50 K within 10% of its lower node) from the species' floor (decision-r08-t4ef-storage section 1.4, E2), refined by bisection to a quarter of E1's step where the chain test (cubic in T on ln sigma, the client's rows at the standard pressures each read between the table's nodes, the read cubic in ln p on tau) fails 2e-3 within its columns (the gated column, and the species' own Rayleigh column, R08.T4.g's ruling); alternate pressure nodes below 1 MPa dropped where it passes (E3), and an 8-a-decade midpoint added between two held rows below 1 MPa where it fails by the read itself (decision-r08-t4e-unsold's follow-up); ln sigma stored in 16 bits a value (decision-r08-t4d-kdist.md; decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md). Below 1000 K the 1000 K node is held, estimated: SiO's visible A-X hot bands reach the range only above about 1000 K (decision-r08-t4ef-storage section 1.4, E2), where its X 12-0 band's 296 K cells are 1e-39 m2; above 4000 K the 4000 K node is held, estimated, SiOUVenIR being valid to 10000 K. Fetched from the database's archive, whose states file differs from the one R08.T4.c summed (SHA-256 acf9fc10...0756), its transitions and .pf the same.
